D/ +[--]DGAR' REX ANG ; R/ ASHV / +++ / NDH[?O]

Silver coin. Penny of Eadger of England (959-975), kindly identified by Martin Allen as HPI (North 742), and the sixth example of an issue of a previously unrecorded moneyer, probably based at York, 959-973. Chipped. Obverse description: Small central cross pattee; a similar cross close to the inner edge of the inner circle. Also initial cross pattee, again the same. Obverse inscription:…
